annotations.title: Get Pinterest pins, profiles and boards

description: Public Pinterest data from search words, profiles, boards or pin links: pins with image or video, title, description, outbound link, saves, comments, product name and price, pinner and board; profile details with followers and pin counts; boards. No login. Useful for trend and product research, creator discovery and visual content sourcing. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/pinterest-scraper on your Apify account (about $0.0015 per pin, profile or board, $0.001 per search preview; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

links.description: Profile, board or pin links, e.g. ["https://www.pinterest.com/nasa/"].

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 100, max 2000). Cost scales with this.

pins_per_source.description: Pins to read per search, profile or board.

profiles_only.description: Only profile and board details, no pins.

name: get_pinterest_pins

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Get Pinterest pins, profiles and boards
